faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know before you start.

whoCanJoin.question: Who can join InternsHub?
whoCanJoin.answer: Anyone aged 18 or older. Verify your email and phone, upload your CV, and choose a package and a track.

uploadCv.question: Do I need to upload a CV?
uploadCv.answer: Yes. Uploading your CV is part of the sign-up step, before you pick your package and track.

aiInterview.question: How does the AI interview work?
aiInterview.answer: The interview runs on desktop only and uses your camera, microphone and screen share. Your level is set by AI.

whenPay.question: When do I pay?
whenPay.answer: You pay after you receive your interview result.

packageStart.question: When does my package time start?
packageStart.answer: Your squad starts once it is full, led by a Senior Team Leader.

certificates.question: Which certificates will I get?
certificates.answer: After your weekly sprints and Senior-approved PRs, you receive a verifiable certificate.
